comments.author: LycorisOni Senior Moderator
comments.body_html: Its way too aggravating to do any time soon. I’d have to fundamentally adjust how the server reads sell price verses offer prices. This also runs the risk of breaking other mods. I don’t know why I would honestly do a feature like this.
